items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Guy Kelly made read music. I know so many fellas that read music.

ctx.x: No I don't think so either.

And Celestan, Celestan has always read music. Guy Kelly made read music. I know so many fellas that read music. He can't tell me that they didn't read music. And so as I was foreseeing about Celestan, that was a band I really enjoyed. The drums, the drummer, Henry Zeno, used to take a solo, or maybe about 24 bars. That's the tune that was playing. And then the drums, and then the drums, and then it falls in again.
You understand? They take the drum solo in those days then.
